##### Project general facts

Allegro Park is a residential building by Mill Hill Developers on Dubai Islands, set where the coastline meets a green park setting. The architecture is designed to blend into its surroundings, with gentle façades, shaded balconies and open breezeways. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, as well as penthouses and townhouses, and every apartment features a private glass-sided plunge pool on the balcony.

The amenity offer brings resort-style living to the building. Residents can enjoy a podium beach-edge pool with a natural sand entry, an adults' rooftop infinity pool and an adults' rooftop cinema, as well as a temperature-controlled podium cinema. A Technogym fitness centre, a spa and wellness centre with saunas, steam rooms and plunge pools, and a podium-level padel court support an active lifestyle, while a splash pad and a children's play area cater to families.

Apartments are delivered semi-furnished with kitchen appliances. Interiors follow a modern and contemporary style that pairs natural palettes with refined textures, creating calm and light-filled living spaces with a resort-style lobby welcoming residents on arrival.    

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods with beaches, marinas, hotels and leisure facilities. The area offers a relaxed coastal lifestyle with open sea views and green spaces, while remaining closely linked to the established districts of the city.

Dubai Islands Beach is only moments away, and Dubai Creek is within a short drive. Dubai International Airport, Dubai International Financial Centre and Downtown Dubai are reachable via the main road network, while Dubai Marina can also be accessed by road.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of beachfront living, marina and hospitality offerings and convenient access to the city's business and travel hubs positions the area for both end users and investors seeking waterfront homes in Dubai.
